patthana21.36:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā hetu ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. tīṇi.
patthana21.36:2.1: na hetuṃ bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.36:3.1: (ajjhatta bahiddhārammaṇaṃ natthi.) na hetuṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
